posts.name: Strawberry 1.0
posts.tagline: AI Browser that saves your team >100h/week
posts.description: Strawberry is an AI browser that can do hours of work in minutes. Strawberry's agents, which we call "Companions", can research hundreds of leads in parallel, transcribe your meetings, automate follow-ups, and handle all the repetitive admin your team keeps procrastinating. Create or hire a pre-made companion, teach it your preferences and share it with your whole team. Hundreds of teams, including Lovable, Tandem Health and ElevenLabs, already use Strawberry.

posts.name: SurgePix
posts.tagline: AI visuals. Edit every layer. Agent-callable.
posts.description: Most AI image tools stop at one-shot generation. SurgePix keeps going: edit any layer, swap text, repaint a region, and stay on-brand with your brand kit. Or skip the UI — open-source agent skills let Claude Code & Cursor generate and edit visuals for you.

posts.name: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
posts.tagline: MiniMax’s Flash model, 3x faster and 70% cheaper for agents
posts.description: MiniMax M3.1 Flash is MiniMax’s new Flash model for agentic tasks, coding, computer use and cybersecurity. MiniMax says it is about 3x faster online and 70% cheaper for agentic tasks than its predecessor, with output at 200+ tokens per second. Pricing is $0.15 input and $0.60 output per 1M tokens. It’s on the MiniMax API, M Plan and MiniMax Code, and weights are promised later.

posts.name: N8N Chat UI
posts.tagline: Beautiful, no-code, on-brand AI chat widgets for n8n
posts.description: N8N Chat UI is a no-code builder for branded AI chat widgets, built for n8n users, agencies, SaaS teams, and businesses. Design a mobile-friendly chat experience with live preview, then connect it to any n8n workflow and embed it anywhere. Unlike default n8n chat, it adds deep customization, streaming, voice and file uploads, flexible layouts, and a JavaScript API for advanced integrations.

posts.name: 2G
posts.tagline: Sampler to create early 2000 Neural Synthesis
posts.description: 2G is a sampler that looks and sounds like an early-2000s handheld devices. We imagined what Neural Synthesis would have been like back then. Describe a sound and 2G makes it. Then edit it and play it from your computer keyboard, or load your own audio instead. 2G is free for Windows and macOS, as a plugin or a standalone app, and starts you with 20 credits for generating sounds. Studio ($10/month, 7-day trial) gives you 200 credits a month.

posts.name: PDF Accessibility Checker by WebYes
posts.tagline: Find PDF accessibility issues for free, with fix guidance
posts.description: Find issues that can make your PDFs difficult for people with disabilities to read or use, including missing image descriptions and problems with headings. See affected content highlighted on the page, review issues by severity, and get instructions on how to fix them. The checker also flags what needs human review. Upload PDFs up to 50 MB or paste a public link. Completely free, with no sign-up, no email required, and no files stored. Checks against WCAG 2.1 AA and PDF/UA.

posts.name: CloudKnife
posts.tagline: Cut your cloud bill, not your performance
posts.description: Cloud cost tools tell you what to cut, then leave the work to you. CloudKnife handles it from A to Z. AI agents learn what every Azure resource is, how it’s really used and what it’s allowed to become. A deterministic core checks every recommendation against hard rules, so your SAP VM only gets SAP-certified options. You approve, CloudKnife executes. Your cloud stays lean and your team gets its time back for innovation.

posts.name: WhoIsCooking
posts.tagline: See which AI agent is heating your Mac and cool it down.
posts.description: A Mac app that shows chip temperature and which AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) is heating your Apple Silicon Mac. One click moves busy work to the efficiency cores, so everything keeps running, cooler. $5 one time.

posts.name: Flipcorder
posts.tagline: A 1991 camcorder for your iPhone, one tape a day
posts.description: Currently #3 in Top Paid Photo & Video on the US App Store 🎉 Flipcorder turns your iPhone into a 1991 camcorder. We have lost touch crafting perfect videos for social media, and Flipcorder encourages you to take shorter "flips" of 20 seconds each throughout your day to enjoy as a home video at the end of the day. No editing, just shoot and enjoy in VHS or DV style. Made for iPhone Duo, works on any iPhone. $4.99 once. No ads, no subscription, no watermark, no account.

posts.name: Kiwi
posts.tagline: A proactive AI assistant that texts you before you ask
posts.description: Kiwi is your proactive assistant. It keeps track of what's coming up, your trips, plans, bills and the people in them, and texts you at the right moment. When something needs doing, it does it on any app or website when you say yes. Your Saturday is free: want a plan with the kids? Your flight is delayed: want a car for when you land? Your parcel needs a signature while you're at work: move it to Saturday? It all happens in iMessage or WhatsApp. Free during the pilot.

posts.name: desigma
posts.tagline: Free Figma alternative made on Rust
posts.description: Free Figma alternative made on Rust. Contribute to deepfounder-ai/desigma development by creating an account on GitHub.

posts.name: tabsh
posts.tagline: Work with agents with an IDE in your browser tab
posts.description: Most ADEs bring the browser into the IDE. tabsh takes the opposite approach: bring coding sessions to your browser, where your work already happens. It's a small Rust daemon that puts all your sessions across projects on one Kanban board/list, with status updates via agent hooks. Use real terminals or chat panels with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI, OpenCode, and more. Free, MIT-licensed, macOS/Linux.

posts.name: ManyAgents
posts.tagline: Run a team of AI coding agents from one Mac window
posts.description: An orchestrator splits your work across Claude Code and Codex agents, each in its own git worktree. A reviewer checks the result, a built-in browser lets agents test their own work, and every question lands in one place. Uses the plans you already have. Free for 14 days.

posts.name: omerta
posts.tagline: Catch .env secrets leaking into git
posts.description: Catchenv secrets leaking into git: a pre-commit hook and CLI that fails when an API key or any value of your env files is staged, tracked or anywhere in the history. Your real values, not patterns.

posts.name: Mozy
posts.tagline: App Blocker for Android & iPhone
posts.description: An app blocker and step counter: walking earns screen-time minutes for the apps you pick, and those apps lock when the minutes run out.

posts.name: VibeiDE
posts.tagline: Queue agent tasks in parallel and review each result
posts.description: Queue Codex and Claude Code tasks across your projects, run them in parallel and review every result. Built for developers and solo founders.

posts.name: AI Bridge
posts.tagline: Every AI coding agent on your Mac, in its place
posts.description: AI Bridge runs Claude Code, Codex, Grok and OpenCode side by side on your Mac: each the real CLI in a real terminal, on your own subscription. Group your agents like a team, by department or by what each one owns. Open a Kubernetes cluster or talk to your database in plain words, right beside them. Prefer terminals? The Grid puts them all on one wall, with cluster and database chats where you need them. Open as many windows as you like, and put agents in Slack that reply when you approve.

posts.name: Loqui
posts.tagline: Turns your voice into ready-to-send text in any Mac app
posts.description: Loqui turns your voice into clean, ready-to-send text in any app on your Mac. Hold a shortcut, speak, and the text lands at your cursor in the tone you pick. It also transcribes meetings and writes the minutes. 90+ languages. Free plan, no card needed.

posts.name: Helio
posts.tagline: Know exactly what your rooftop solar made today
posts.description: Rooftop solar apps make you dig for the one number you want: units made today. Helio opens straight on it, read from your inverter's own energy counter via ShineMonitor / SmartClient. Also: live power, any past day as a 5-minute curve, 30-day, yearly and lifetime history, and savings in your own currency and tariff. Deploy your own copy to Vercel in 5 minutes. Free, MIT licensed, no database, no tracking. Your login never reaches the browser.

posts.name: AVP
posts.tagline: Open source alternative to Git for AI coding agents
posts.description: Worktrees isolate your agents. AVP integrates them: every change proven on the exact head of main before it lands.

posts.name: Jobmate AI
posts.tagline: The humanized AI Copilot for your entire Job search
posts.description: Jobmate AI takes the busywork of job hunting off your plate so your energy goes into landing interviews. An AI agent auto-applies for you, autofills any application form from your profile and answers the open-ended questions. Find fresh roles from across the web, tailor your resume and cover letter to each one, reach the recruiters and hiring managers behind it, and track every application and interview in one place. Free to start on Chrome and Firefox.

posts.name: Knock
posts.tagline: Create shortcuts by hitting your mac
posts.description: Knock is a shortcut app that lets you control your Mac by simply knocking on it. Tap the sides of your laptop and it runs any shortcut you want — screenshot, open apps, mute sound, and more. It uses your Mac's built-in accelerometer to actually feel the vibration of your knock and react in real time, no extra hardware needed - just knock and go.

posts.name: AllModels
posts.tagline: Explore every abliterated model
posts.description: Route abliterated language models across providers with automatic fallbacks, modality-aware selection, and one place to compare availability and token prices.

posts.name: Standfast
posts.tagline: Know if your Mac's GitHub Actions runners will get work
posts.description: A free macOS menu bar app for self-hosted GitHub Actions runners. It asks launchd whether each runner is alive and GitHub whether it still counts on it, and never mixes up the two answers.

posts.name: SwarmPane
posts.tagline: 22 updates in 17 days: usage limits per account & more
posts.description: Since our first launch: 22 updates in 17 days, many shipped the same day a user asked. SwarmPane runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor and 9 more AI coding agents side by side, on the plans you already pay for. New: every account's usage limits in your toolbar, each agent in its own worktree, Devin and Hermes, one rules file and MCP setup for every agent, and sessions that survive restarts. Mac, Windows, Linux.

posts.name: Figcel
posts.tagline: Turn your store and rivals' ads into Meta ads and carousels.
posts.description: Paste your store link. Figcel studies the ads your competitors are running in the public Meta Ad Library and turns them into finished Meta ad carousels and Instagram motion carousels for your products. For D2C & Ecom brands and the agencies behind them. Plans from $99/month.

posts.name: ScratchBoard
posts.tagline: Build complex business apps in minutes using Ai
posts.description: Build business apps with AI. Describe what you need — ScratchBoard builds entities, workflows, portals, dashboards, and more.

posts.name: Open_SwarmForce
posts.tagline: A swarm of agents for making your coding easy
posts.description: SWARMFORGE is an agentic CI/CD gate for the change path that matters: it reviews a committed or working-tree diff, can group and fix confirmed findings in isolated sandboxes, re-reviews the result, then requires deterministic repository checks before it publishes a PR. It runs with OpenAI Codex/GPT, any OpenRouter model, local open-source models (Ollama, LM Studio), or Claude Code (claude -p, opt-in) — with cost-aware routing measured on an L0–L6 benchmark ladder.

posts.name: Tortoise
posts.tagline: Fractal torus and sacred geometry. Free and open source.
posts.description: Generate variations of a fractal torus in your browser. Shape it as visions seen in meditation or altered states, create light fields as plasma, create rendered images with AI based on its structure, and export perfect video loops, 16K posters, plotter lines and 3D prints. Free and open source. (Best viewed in desktop)

posts.name: Vesalius
posts.tagline: 51% fewer tokens for Claude Code
posts.description: Vesalius reads your repository once, right on your Mac, and remembers how everything connects: which file uses which, who calls what, where a feature actually lives. Claude Code can then ask it directly and get answers with exact file and line references, usually in one call instead of a chain of searches. In our benchmark that cut token use roughly in half with no measurable change in answer quality. Vesalius itself never uploads your code.

posts.name: Sonah
posts.tagline: Reviews what your coding agent did, not just the diff
posts.description: Coding agents rewrite code you never asked them to touch, and the tests still pass. Sonah reads the agent’s Claude Code or Codex session along with the code, then shows on one page: whether each ask was done, what the agent decided on its own, which of its claims its own results contradict, and what is wrong in the code. Every quote is checked word for word. Runs locally through your own Claude login. No account, no telemetry. Free for individuals.

posts.name: Founder Marketing Blueprint
posts.tagline: The complete marketing engine to get your first users
posts.description: You built the product. Now get the users. DesignTech AI is a launch and marketing engine built for solo founders. Generate the exact landing pages, emails, and social posts you need to acquire early adopters, everywhere they hang out. The Founder Marketing Blueprint is a proven framework built on 25 years of go-to-market experience. Free to start, our structured approach ensures every minute and credit spent on the platform goes directly toward assets that drive immediate user growth.

posts.name: Vital
posts.tagline: Blood, when it’s needed
posts.description: Vital alerts nearby, eligible blood donors the moment a request goes up. Free, voluntary, and private.

posts.name: Toolore
posts.tagline: 78 free browser tools — no sign-up, nothing uploaded
posts.description: 78 free tools in one place: India tax and salary calculators, unit converters, text and developer utilities, and PDF tools. Everything runs in your browser, so files you drop in never leave your device. No account, no limits. Every calculator shows its formula.

posts.name: FaaStr
posts.tagline: You're not missing a tool. You're missing a co-founder.
posts.description: FaaStr builds your company's knowledge graph as you work — every idea, decision, customer and number connected and current in your own Drive. So when an investor asks, an early-stage, pre-revenue SaaS startup looks like it has been running a data room all along.

posts.name: Squario
posts.tagline: The CRM and operations platform for SMEs
posts.description: All-in-one operations platform for SMEs: CRM and pipeline, scoping and proposals, projects, time, budgets, expenses and dashboards, with an AI assistant and an MCP server.

posts.name: Drone Show Arts
posts.tagline: Turn your idea into a drone light show in minutes
posts.description: Build a drone show concept, review it in 3D, create a visual storyboard, and prepare files for your drone operator's production pipeline. Describe your event or pick from 1,000+ ready figures. Built for weddings, brand launches, real estate, sports and festivals.

posts.name: Twinalyze
posts.tagline: AI-Powered Product Analytics for Smarter Decisions
posts.description: Twinalyze is an AI-powered product analytics platform that helps businesses understand user behavior, optimize product performance, and make smarter, data-driven decisions. From real-time analytics and automatic event tracking to user journeys, retention, conversion, and engagement insights, Twinalyze brings everything together in one powerful platform. With AI-driven insights, customizable reports, ads intelligence, and personalized messaging, growth and marketing teams to uncover opportunities

posts.name: usertank
posts.tagline: connects consumer products to ideal users for fast feedback
posts.description: usertank connects builders with real people for short paid calls and product tests, so you hear what they need, what confuses them, and what to build next.

posts.name: ContextPod
posts.tagline: Move your Claude chat to ChatGPT without re-explaining
posts.description: You hit Claude’s message limit mid-project and have to brief ChatGPT from zero. ContextPod packs your whole chat into a summary in one click — paste it into ChatGPT or Gemini and carry on where you stopped. Free, no account, everything stays in your browser.

posts.name: Faktory
posts.tagline: Reliable background jobs for any language, over one protocol
posts.description: Faktory is an open-source background job server by Mike Perham, the creator of Sidekiq. Producers push jobs as JSON and workers fetch them over a small protocol, so any language can use it: official Ruby and Go clients, community ones for Python, Node, PHP, Rust, Elixir, Java,NET and more. A fetched job is reserved, not removed: if a worker crashes, it comes back. Failures retry with backoff, then land in a Dead set you can re-run. Web UI included.

posts.name: Avion Calc: Time Calculator
posts.tagline: Time Arithmetic Calculator
posts.description: Introducing our brand-new full fledged Time Calculator! Eliminate mental math and simplify time arithmetic for pilots, crew, and productivity power users. You can now seamlessly add, subtract, multiply, divide, and calculate percentages across mixed time formats in a single equation. Whether you're working with entries like 1h 2m 1s, 1.5h, or total minutes like 120m, Avion Calc processes them effortlessly—supporting multi-step math and parentheses e.g., (4h 15m + 1h 45m) ÷ (2 + 1) = 2h 00m.

posts.name: Gmail power tools by Leadomator
posts.tagline: Free Chrome tools that fix Gmail's most annoying gaps
posts.description: Four free Chrome extensions for people who live in Gmail: block a sender in one click, auto-mark mail as read with simple rules, get warned before sending from the wrong address or alias, and close empty tab groups automatically. They send no telemetry.

posts.name: CineWall
posts.tagline: Turn laptops into a browser-based video wall
posts.description: CineWall turns laptops into a shared movie-night setup. Play your own video across 2–3 screens, share music across up to 5 laptop speakers, or present your screen to up to 10 devices. Use your phone as a microphone, too. Connect to the same Wi-Fi or hotspot and open your browser. Free to use, with no app or extension to install.

posts.name: Shovra
posts.tagline: Designer portfolio shots from full-page screens in seconds
posts.description: Drop in a full-page scroll. Shovra slices it, frames it, and builds your case study in seconds. It detects the device, splits long designs into sections, places each in a pixel-perfect iPhone, iPad or browser mockup, and matches the background to your design's colors. No template hunting. No smart objects. No slicing by hand. No lost weekends. Built for UI/UX designers and freelancers who land clients on Dribbble, Behance, Upwork or their own portfolio. Pay once, no subscription.

posts.name: iwantmy.ai Retro
posts.tagline: Chat with an AI that's stuck in 1985
posts.description: Pick a computer from 1970 to 1995, type a question, and an AI answers in character, as if it were still that year. Eight machines, each rebuilt pixel by pixel in plain JavaScript and CSS. Free, no sign-up.

posts.name: GateKeeperZero
posts.tagline: Society Management Software & App in India
posts.description: Visitor management, GST billing, amenity booking and 420+ features for Indian housing societies. Basic free forever, Standard included for your first 90 days, no lock-in beyond your paid year.

posts.name: GSC Magic
posts.tagline: Connect Google Search Console to your AI agent
posts.description: GSC Magic is a hosted MCP server that gives Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP client your real Search Console, Bing, GA4 and Tag Manager data. Sign in with Google, paste one URL, ask. 77 tools, ready-made SEO reports, read-only by default. Free plan.

posts.name: Stowshelf
posts.tagline: Save links, images, notes & places in visual collections
posts.description: Keep design references, trip ideas, recipes, and reading lists in one searchable place. Save links, images, notes, and places with the Stowshelf browser extension, then organize your finds into visual collections by project or interest. Start free. Pro adds search by meaning, related discovery, and unlimited sync and sharing.

posts.name: TallyNexa
posts.tagline: Live dashboards, GST checks and AI for TallyPrime books
posts.description: TallyNexa turns TallyPrime data into decisions. A small connector on your Tally computer syncs every company every two minutes, so cash, receivables, payables, stock and GST are live in your browser. See whom to call first, check GST returns against GSTR-2B before you file, and drill 40+ reports down to the entry. Nexa AI answers in plain words from your ledger and makes slides, Word and Excel files. Built for Indian businesses, finance teams and CA firms.

posts.name: OkayToShip
posts.tagline: Check your AI-built app before launch, in a minute
posts.description: Paste a link to your app or Telegram bot (beta). In about a minute: a launch-readiness score across 7 areas — security, payments, SEO, speed, design, legal, API costs — and a ready fix prompt for Lovable, Bolt, Cursor or Replit. Free scan.

posts.name: AI Training Jobs
posts.tagline: Every open AI training job from 14 platforms in one place
posts.description: Every AI training job worth applying to, in one list. AI labs pay doctors, lawyers, engineers, writers and native speakers to review and improve AI answers. AI Training Jobs brings those roles into one list, updated daily, so you can see what each pays, which countries can apply, and how each platform screens people before you spend an hour on an application.

posts.name: vCorso
posts.tagline: AI race photo-to-video highlights and 3D route replays
posts.description: Finished a race and only have photos? vCorso turns your event photos into cinematic video highlights, no existing footage needed. Bring your favourite shots to life with AI-generated slow-motion clips, matched to real Garmin, Strava or Wahoo performance data. Create 4 photo-based highlight videos per month for free, with stats, route maps and weather overlays. Add paid AI motion to animate your best moments or share unlimited free interactive 3D route replays.

posts.name: NextTransit
posts.tagline: See the next train at your stops
posts.description: NextTransit shows the next train arriving at your preferred stops — minimal input, live predictions where the agency provides them and the published schedule otherwise. Free on iOS and Android.

posts.name: Edu-Soft
posts.tagline: All-in-one school management, from admissions to results
posts.description: Edu-Soft is a cloud-based school management system that handles students, teachers, attendance, exams, marksheets, admit cards, and fee collection in one place. It’s multi-tenant, role-based, and works in light and dark mode. Teachers can mark attendance and enter results in seconds, while admins track fees, expenses, and financial reports with charts. Every institution’s data is fully isolated, so your school’s information stays private and secure.

posts.name: Loopoku
posts.tagline: A quiet, solo loop puzzle for iPhone
posts.description: A quiet, solo loop puzzle for iPhone and iPad. Turn stone paths into one closed loop. Free, offline and ad-free. Coming soon.

posts.name: Fil
posts.tagline: AI canvas for images, video, 3D, code and audio
posts.description: Fil is a canvas for generating images, video, 3D, code and audio with the best models, plus an MCP server so AI agents can use it. Ready-made workflows cover brand guides, product promo videos and motion films. Free plan with daily credits.

posts.name: CloudPost
posts.tagline: Your email in any AI assistant, via MCP
posts.description: A free, hosted, private MCP server for email. Connect iCloud, Fastmail, Outlook or any IMAP/SMTP account to your AI assistant. Passwords are encrypted, and CloudPost doesn't keep a copy of your mailbox. Built entirely in Amp.

posts.name: ScreenWarden for Roku
posts.tagline: Screen Time and Parental Controls for Roku Devices
posts.description: ScreenWarden for Roku puts you in charge of screen time on every Roku TV and Roku player in your home, right from your Windows PC. Enhanced parental controls allow daily limits for apps, schedule nightly bedtimes, wake up to your favorite channel, launch apps remotely, and lock it all behind a password. ScreenWarden runs quietly in the system tray and looks after your Roku devices for you. There is no account to create and no cloud. Everything stays on your PC.

posts.name: Blur Image
posts.tagline: Blur a photo in your browser, nothing gets uploaded
posts.description: Open a screenshot or a photo in the Chrome side panel, blur the whole image or drag a box over the parts you want hidden, then save or copy the result. Everything runs on your own computer: no upload, no account, and the file keeps its original format.

posts.name: Repotruck
posts.tagline: Bulk-clone and organize your GitHub repositories
posts.description: Bulk-clone and organize your GitHub repos into preset layouts with an AGENTS.md map for AI coding agents. One command via npx on Windows, macOS and Linux.

posts.name: Zykub
posts.tagline: The AI Teammate That Plans and Assigns Your Team's Work
posts.description: Zykub learns your team from their CVs, skills, workload and past work. Paste a project brief and our matching model assigns every task to the person who fits best and has time, then Zykub checks the work against the brief.

posts.name: Hiraiship
posts.tagline: Ship to the edge in a flash
posts.description: Deploying a web app usually means managing servers, CI and DNS before anyone sees your work. Hiraiship removes that step: you connect a GitHub repo, and then every push goes live on Cloudflare's global network. It was first built for Rasengan.js, but it now supports Vite, Astro, Next.js, React Router, TanStack Start, Hono and more. On top of that, you get live build logs, one-click rollback, custom domains with HTTPS and team workspaces. Best of all, there's a free plan to start.

posts.name: Loreflow
posts.tagline: Your company's memory — answers with sources attached
posts.description: Loreflow is an AI company brain for fast-moving teams. Connect GitHub and Slack, and Loreflow builds a shared memory of decisions, insights, tasks and reports. Ask in plain English and get an answer with the evidence attached — and when the evidence isn't there, it says so. Built for teams tired of re-arguing settled decisions, onboarding by shadowing one person, and losing context when someone leaves.

posts.name: MediaShift
posts.tagline: Convert media in your browser. Nothing uploaded.
posts.description: MediaShift runs FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly right in your browser. Convert video, audio and images across 22 formats — MP4, WebM, GIF, MP3, WAV, PNG, JPG, WebP. Compress photos to exact sizes for online forms. No upload, no account, no watermark. Works offline.

posts.name: DESIGN:OS Figma Plugin & CLI
posts.tagline: Let your AI coding agent read and edit your open Figma file
posts.description: A free Figma plugin + CLI that lets Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Antigravity inspect and edit the file you have open. Local WebSocket on 127.0.0.1, one undo step per mutation, PNG export to verify changes, zero telemetry. Source-available.

posts.name: Gemini Watermark Remover by DevriQ Tools
posts.tagline: Remove Gemini watermarks from AI images online instantly.
posts.description: Gemini Watermark Remover by DevriQ Tools lets creators, marketers, and brands instantly clean up Gemini-generated visuals for commercial presentations, portfolios, websites, and social media campaigns. No watermarks, no blurred corners, and no account registration required. Upload your image, remove the corner badge in seconds, and download crisp, full-resolution graphics ready for client delivery and professional branding—100% free and private inside your browser.

posts.name: Sortfully
posts.tagline: Your Outlook inbox, sorted by who sent it. Automatically.
posts.description: Sortfully files your Outlook and Microsoft 365 mail by the organisation that sent it, once you’ve read it. Connect a mailbox and leave it: it sorts new mail on its own. Want more control? Group domains into one folder, use coloured tags instead, pin a sender to a folder you already have, or file mail as soon as it lands. No AI, just rules you can see. It never reads message bodies or attachments, and every move can be undone.

posts.name: BusinessChat
posts.tagline: Turn any website into a chatbot and a link to pitch it
posts.description: Paste a website and get a chatbot that answers only from its pages, in the site's colours. Put it on your site with one line of code, or send a business a link where they try it on their own site. See what they asked, then pitch.

posts.name: Whisperstream
posts.tagline: Private Dictation for Windows and Mac
posts.description: Local-first AI dictation for Windows and Mac (beta) now completely free and open source! Our own finetuned Stream-1 Mini provides local cleanup. And per-app customization profiles, encrypted history, and Agent Speak to hear and speak back to your Claude Code and Codex.

posts.name: Gostman
posts.tagline: Open source API client. No account, no cloud sync.
posts.description: A free alternative to Postman, Insomnia and Bruno that needs no account. REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, Socket.IO and MQTT in one app, with collections saved as plain files you can commit. The desktop app, web app and CLI run the same Go engine, so a CI run matches what you saw while testing. Secrets stay in your own manager, and an MCP server lets coding agents send saved requests with values redacted. MIT licensed.

posts.name: Takibi Base
posts.tagline: Shared knowledge and tasks for AI agents
posts.description: Takibi Base gives your AI agents shared documents and a task board. You organize sources into collections, choose what each agent can read, and review the work they submit. Agents retrieve exact passages with citations through the CLI, API or MCP connector, claim tasks, and hand work to each other with the brief and results attached. Takibi doesn't generate answers.

posts.name: Mantra Counter: 108 Mala Jaap
posts.tagline: Mantra counter 108 mala tracker, devotional, stories, music
posts.description: Experience the ultimate digital companion for your daily spiritual practice with Mantra Jaap Counter. Whether you are chanting a 108 mala, doing naam jaap, or meditating, our free online mantra counter is designed to keep you focused, peaceful, and connected. Simply tap the button or press the spacebar to count your chants. Complete 108 chants to finish one Mala—your total chants and malas are tracked simultaneously! 🚫 No Ads During Chanting! We respect your peace of mind.

posts.name: Foundry
posts.tagline: Your agent posts TikToks, Reels + Shorts from real iPhones
posts.description: Foundry runs Instagram, TikTok and YouTube on real iPhones you own, driven by the AI agent you already use. Queue an approved video and it posts Reels, TikToks and Shorts, warms your accounts, and hands back a receipt for every post.

posts.name: Globebug
posts.tagline: Plan, navigate, and remember every trip in one place
posts.description: Globebug is a connected travel platform that brings the entire journey into one place. Save travel inspirations, build detailed multi-destination itineraries, organize activities, routes and budgets, and understand your trip's pacing with Trip Pulse.
